source: Hearing from God
target: Okuwulira okuva eri Katonda

source: God wants to speak to everyone. Are we familiar with the ways He speaks? And are we listening and ready to do what He says?
target: Katonda ayagala okw'ogera eri buly'omu. Omanyi engeri gy'ayogeramu? Tuwuliriza era tulibetegefu okukola ky'agamba?

source: We use the word “hearing”, but we need to be aware that God is Spirit and uses all our senses to communicate with us. That means we’re actually “sensing” God.
target: Tukozesa ekigambo “kuwulira”, naye tulina okumanya nti Katonda Mwoyo era akozesa empulira zaffe zonna okw'ogera naffe. Ekyo kitegeza nti “tusensinga” Katonda.

source: Everyone can hear something from God. But in order to hear from Him regularly and to live in a relationship with God, it is necessary that we are filled with the Holy Spirit. Then He is living in us and shaping our thinking and our feelings more and more so that we can sense more clearly what God wants to say to us.
target: Buly'omu asobola okubako ky'awulira okuva eri Katonda. Naye olyoke omuwulire bulikadde era obere nenkolagana ne Katonda, ky'etagisibwa okubanga tujjuzibwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Awo abera muffe era ateleza endowoza zaffe n'empulira zaffe ffe okusobola okuwulilira ddala Mukama ky'ayagala okutugamba.

source: There can be obstacles hindering or even blocking the communication between God and us. This could be sin that I need to turn away from, a distraction, or a hurt. The more we clean these out, the better we can hear from God.
target: Wayinza okuberawo ebiziyiza oba ebitasobozesa mpuliziganya yaffe ne Katonda. Kinno kiyinza okubera ekibbi kyenyina okwesonyiwa, obukosefu oba obulumi. Gyetukoma okulongosa binno, gyetweyongera okubanga tusobora okuwulira okuva eri Katonda.

source: The aim is that we know God and live in close communication with Him just like with a good friend.
target: Ekigendelerwa kwekubanga tumanya Katonda era n'okubanga empuliziganya yaffe eri kumpi nga mukwano go omulungi.

source: What is distracting me from sensing God? Are there areas in my life where I don’t want to listen to God? Why?
target: Kiiki ekinemesa okutegera Katonda? Waliwo ebituntu mubulamu bwange wesagala kuwuliliza Katonda? Lwakki?

source: Am I sure that the Holy Spirit is living in me?
target: Nkakasa nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu abeera munze?

source: Ways God speaks to us
target: Engeri Mukama gy'ayogera naffe.

source: Bible
target: Bayibuli

source: The Bible is like God’s letter for all of us and contains all the main things God wants us to know (2 Timothy 3:16). Everything that God speaks will be in agreement with the Bible.
target: Bayibuli eringa ebaluwa ya Katonda gyetuli era erimu ebintu ebyamakulu Katonda by'ayagala tumanye (2Timosewo 3:16). Bulikimu Mukama ky'ayogera kijjakuba nga kiikiligizanya ne Bayibuii.

source: Other people
target: Abantu abalala

source: It is normal that God speaks to you through your leaders or trainers as God has given them the role and responsibility to guide you well. God is also giving other brothers and sisters certain roles or wisdom to build up His family. So someone may come up to you and his words for you might be from God. (2 Samuel 12:1-13; 1 Corinthians 14:3; Hebrews 13:17)
target: Kyabulijjo nti Mukama ayogera nawe okuyita mu bakulembezebo oba abatendesi nga Mukama bw'abawade obuvunayizibwa obw'okulungamya obulungi. Mukama awa ab'oluganda abalala obuvunanyizibwa obuumu oba amagezi okuzimba amakage. N'olw'ekyo omuntu yena ayinza okujja jj'oli era n'ekigambo kye jj'oli kiyinza okubera nga kiva eri Katonda. (2Samwili 12:1-13, 1Abakolinso 14:3; Abebulania 13:17)

source: Inner thoughts and impressions
target: Empulira eyomunda n'okusomozebwa

source: When the Holy Spirit lives in us, He shapes our thoughts and can give us impressions at any time. This could be through our conscience and through thoughts that come up and remind us of the things that God wants. Or we might see something like a picture in our mind’s eye by which God wants to show us something (Acts 10:10-11).
target: Omwoyo Omutukuvu bw'abera muffe, awagara endowoza zaffe era asobora okutusomoza mukaseera konna. Kinno kiyinza okubera mukuyita mundowoza zaffe ezijja era nezitujukiza ebintu Katonda by'ayagala. Oba tusobola okulaba ebintu ebiimu nga ekifananyi liiso ly'endowoza zaffe Katonda mw'ayagalira okubako ky'atulaga (Ebikolwa by'abatume 10:10-11).

source: Incidents
target: By'oyinza okulabirako

source: God has given us eyes, ears, and a mind so that we use them. Sometimes we see someone we should help. This might be God speaking by making people come across each other. In such situations we can first observe and then ask God what our responsibility is (Matthew 11:2-6; 27:54).
target: Katonda atuwade amaaso, amaatu, n'endowoza tusobore okubikozesa. Ebisera ebimu tulaba omuntu gwetusana okuyamba. Mukinno ayinza okubera Katonda nga yayogera nga aletera abantu okujja awaamu kulwabuly'omu. Mumbera nga eyo tusobora okusokeradala kwetegereza oluvanyuma netubuza Katonda nti obuvunayizibwa bwaffe bwebuliwa (Mataayo 11:2-6;27:54).

source: Dreams
target: Ebirooto

source: God can speak to us while we’re sleeping. We can learn to interpret dreams to understand what they mean (Job 33:14-17; Genesis 40:1-41:40; Matthew 1:20).
target: Katonda asobora okwogera naffe nga twebasse. Tusobora okuyiga okuvunura ebirooto okutegera kiiki kyebitegeza (Yobu 33:14-17; Olubereberye 40:1,41:40; Mataayo 1:20).

source: Through which of these channels does God often speak to me? How can I learn more in this area? In which other area do I want to learn to sense God?
target: Ngeriki okuyita mu mikuttu gyinno Katonda mw'atera okwogerera nange? Nyinza ntya okuyiga ebisingawo mu kitundu kinno? Kitundu ki ekilara mwenetaga okuyiga okuwulila Katonda?

source: Three different voices
target: Amalobozi asaatu agenjawulo

source: In our lives we are constantly hearing different opinions, so we need to learn to discern which source they come from: From God? From people (myself and others)? Or from the devil?
target: Mubulamu bwaffe tuwulira endowoza ezenjawulo, n'olw'ekyo twetaga okuyiga okwekenenya ludawa gyezivude: Zivude eri Katonda? Eri bantu (nze mwenyini oba abalala)? Oba okuva eri sitaani?

source: These are characteristics of the different voices:
target: Binno byebimu ku malobozi agenjawulo:

source: The voice of God
target: Edobozi Lya Katonda

source: The voice of people
target: Edobozi ly'abantu

source: The voice of the devil
target: Edobozi lya sitaani

source: * encouraging, full of love, good, perfect (Romans 12:2) * can be inconvenient: revealing sin, challenging us * intention: to build up, to heal, to correct
target: *Nga lizamu amanyi, lijjude okwagala, lilunji, litukilide (Abaluumi 12:2) *Lisobora okubera ezzibu: nga likubikulira ekibbi, nga litusomoza *Ebigendererwa: okukulakulanya, okuwonya, okuteleza

source: * can be good or bad advice * limited perspective * filtered through own experiences and expectations
target: *Lisobola okubera okuwabula okulunji oba okubbi *Okutangazibwa okutono *Nga likenenudwa okuyitta mu bumanyililivu bwaffe n'entebeleza zaffe

source: * frightening, discouraging * creating divisions, discord * intention: to shame, to blame, to accuse, to tear down
target: *Nga litisa, limalamu amanyi *Nga litondawo enjawukana, lyawula *Lilubilira kuswaza, kunenya, kutagulula, kuyuzamu wansi

source: Exercise: Take a situation where you need to make a decision. Divide the thoughts and voices connected to it according to their sources into the three categories God, people, devil.
target: Okugezesa: Twala embera awo w'oyagara okutwala okusalawo. Yawula endowoza n'amalobozi ebikwatagana ku mbeera eyo okusinzila ku nsibuko y'abyo mungeri saatu Katonda, abantu, sitaani.

source: Discerning: What is from God? (1 Thessalonians 5:19-21)
target: Okwekanya: Kiiki ekiva eri Katonda? (1 Abasessalonika 5:19-21)

source: What does the Bible say about it? The Bible is the most important authority to test something. If something is contradicting God’s principles in the Bible, then it’s not from God.
target: Bayibuli egambaki ku kyo? Bayibuli y'esinga obuyinza okugezesa ekintu. Ekinti singa kibera nga kikontanna n'engeri za Mukama mu Bayibuli, awo tekiva eri Katonda.

source: Is it good? Does it align with the character of God?
target: Kilunji? Kikwatagana n'embara ya Katonda?

source: What do other mature brothers and sisters say about it? If you’re unsure, ask your leader or trainer for advice.
target: Ab'oluganda abakulu abalala bakyogerako ki? Bw'obanga tewekakasa, buuza omukulembezewo oba omutendesi ku kuwabulwa.

source: How trustworthy is the source I got it from?
target: Buli butya obw'esigwa bwensibuko gyenakifunye?

source: God doesn’t want to dictate us every detail about our life – He gives us the freedom to make choices. He wants us to take steps closer to Him by trusting Him and by taking responsibility for our decisions.
target: Katonda tayagala kuvujilira bulikikwata ku bulamu bwaffe- Atuwa edembbe okukola okusalawo. Atwagala tutwale edala okumusembelera nga tumwesiga era nga tutwala obuvunanyizibwa kukusalawo kwaffe.

source: There are some questions where it is easier to hear God’s answers (Examples: “God, who do I need to forgive?” “Where do you see sin in my life and want me to repent?”)
target: Waliwo ebibuuzo ebiimu nga kyanguwa okuwulila okwanukula kwa Mukama (Eby'okulabirako: “Katonda, anni gwenetaga okusonyiwa?” “Ludawa w'olaba ekibbi mu bulamu bwange era nga onetaga okw'enenya?”)

source: With other questions it is harder to discern God’s voice (“God, who should I marry?”), and some, God probably won’t answer at the moment (“How will my next 20 years look?”)
target: Eri ebibuuzo ebilara kizibu okwekeneya edobozi lya Katonda (“Mukama, anni gweninna okuwasa?”), eri ebimu, Katonda ayinza obutakudamu mu kaseera akko (“Emmyaka gyange amakumi abiiri 20years ejjija jjinafanana jjitya?”)

source: Sometimes we get stuck in asking why-questions. Often these aren’t helpful to our immediate lives and growth. Or we couldn’t deal with the answer so God won’t give it to us.
target: Ebisera ebimu tusigalira emabega wakati mu kubuza ebibuuzo. Ebisera ebimu nga tebiyamba eri obulamu bwaffe kw'osa nenkula yaffe. Oba nga tetusobola kuwanilira kudibwamu kwaffe n'olw'ekyo Mukama tatuwa ky'akudibwamu.

source: Which questions am I asking God? Are they good questions?
target: Bibuuzo ki byembuza Katonda? Bibuuzo bilunji?

source: Two extremes about dealing with God’s voice
target: Engeri biiri ez'okukwataganya edoboozi lya Katonda

source: Belief:
target: Kilizza:

source: God doesn’t talk to me.
target: Katonda tayogera nange.

source: Everything I hear is from God.
target: Bulikimu kyempulira kiva eri Katonda.

source: Typical:
target: Kyangeri:

source: “My thoughts are not God’s thoughts.”
target: “Endowooza zange si ndowooza za Mukama.”

source:
“God says … !”
“I don’t need to test this.”
target:
“Katonda agamba...!”
“Setaga kugezesa kinno.”

source: The truth:
target: Amazima:

source: The Holy Spirit is in you, that’s why many of your thoughts are God’s thoughts!
target: Omwoyo Omutukuvu ali mugwe, y'ensoga lwaki ebilowoozo byo ebisinga bya Katonda!

source: We’re still human and still make mistakes, so we all misunderstand God sometimes.
target: Tukyali bantu era tukyakola ensobi, n'olw'ekyo ffena tutegera buubi Katonda ebisera ebiimu.

source: Suggestions:
target: Ebitesedwa:

source: Assume that many of your thoughts are from God.
target: Lowoza nti ebisinga ku ndowooza zo ziva eri Katonda.

source: Always start with “I think God says …”
target: Tandika nga “Ndowooza Katonda agamba...”

source: To which side of these two extremes do I tend to? Where does this background come from? How can I become free from that and deal more healthily with God’s voice?
target: Sayidiki kuzinno ebiiri gyendubilira? Ebimu ku binno biviraludawa? Nyinza ntya okufuna edembe mw'ekyo era nkolagane n'edoboozi lya Mukama mungeri ennamu okusingawo?
